title: Effect of Cu(II) compound containing dipicolinic acid on DNA damage: a study of antiproliferative activity and DNA interaction properties by spectroscopic, molecular docking and molecular dynamics approaches.
authors: Heidari, Ameneh; Dehghanian, Effat; Razmara, Zohreh; Shahraki, Somaye; Samareh Delarami, Hojat; Heidari Majd, Mostafa
one_liner_zh: 该文研究铜配合物与DNA的相互作用，采用光谱实验和分子对接/动力学模拟，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作建模方法，但对象为小分子-DNA而非TF-DNA体系，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: A polymeric compound formulized as [Cu(micro-dipic)(2)Na(2)(micro-H(2)O)(4)](n).2nH(2)O (I), where dipic is 2,6-pyridine dicarboxylic acid (dipicolinic acid, H(2)dipic), was synthesized by sonochemical irradiation. The initial in-vitro cytotoxic activity of this complex compared with renowned anticancer drugs like cisplatin, versus HCT116 colon cell lines, shows promising results. This study investigated the interaction mode between compound (I) and calf-thymus DNA utilizing a range of analytical techniques including spectrophotometry, fluorimetry, partition coefficient analysis, viscometry, gel electrophoresis and molecular docking technique. The results obtained from experimental methods reveal complex (I) could bind to CT-DNA via hydrogen bonding and van der Waals forces and the theoretical methods support it. Also, complex (I) indicates nuclease activity in the attendance of H(2)O(2) and can act as an artificial nuclease to cleave DNA with high efficiency.
abstract_zh: 一种聚合化合物，化学式为[Cu(μ-dipic)₂Na₂(μ-H₂O)₄]ₙ·2nH₂O (I)，其中dipic为2,6-吡啶二甲酸（吡啶二羧酸，H₂dipic），通过声化学辐照合成。该配合物与知名抗癌药物如顺铂相比，对HCT116结肠细胞系的初步体外细胞毒性活性显示出有前景的结果。本研究利用一系列分析技术，包括分光光度法、荧光法、分配系数分析、粘度测定法、凝胶电泳和分子对接技术，探讨了化合物(I)与小牛胸腺DNA之间的相互作用模式。实验方法获得的结果表明，配合物(I)可通过氢键和范德华力与CT-DNA结合，且理论方法支持这一结论。此外，配合物(I)在H₂O₂存在下表现出核酸酶活性，可作为人工核酸酶高效切割DNA。
